verdict.rationale: Zero is an open-source email client that connects to Gmail and Outlook through OAuth/provider integrations. The evidence never mentions IMAP, JMAP or SMTP access, and never mentions export in a standard format such as mbox or EML. Self-hosting, the MCP tool API and storing mail in Durable Objects/R2 are related features, not open-protocol access or standards-based export, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As a switcher, my mail stays reachable over open protocols and standard formats — IMAP/JMAP/SMTP access and standards-based export — so no client can lock me in
